ops.name: 채 어르신
ops.look: thin old man in a faded tracksuit and cloth shoes, moving slowly on the sand with his eyes half closed
ops.role: a retired bathhouse owner who learned tai chi in Qingdao and, sleepless, practises on the playground sand every night
ops.says: 태극권을 배우고 싶어? 우선 무릎을 살짝 굽히고, 숨을 길게 내쉬어 봐.

ops.text: 저 할아버지요? 밤마다 저기서 하세요, 처음엔 귀신인 줄 알았다니까요.
모래밭 위에서 느린 그림자 하나가 구름을 밀듯 팔을 천천히 들어 올린다.

채 어르신, a retired bathhouse owner who learned tai chi in Qingdao, practises on the playground sand of the forecourt every sleepless night and will teach anyone who asks; in the morning he joins the 어르신 exercising in the complex's small park.

events.summary: Under the lamp by the playground, an old man who can't sleep is already moving through slow tai chi forms, and he waves you over.
